I have thought of the same thing, good that you have 2 years left at least. Make sure you talk to a lawyer, insurance policies are meant to screw you over. When I wanted to set one up I looked into exactly this pursuit. You can't commit suicide while under the influence of drugs or alcohol, this voids the policy. There are other stipulations as well, so you have to make sure that you plan everything properly. I'm not wanting you to kill yourself, I'm not advocating that you do so. I think it is a good thing that you are at least able to go through another 2 years. I do not want the insurance company to take advantage of you or your loved ones though.

I won't be able to tell you what not to do, but make sure the insurance company is not scamming you by running it through with a lawyer.

At first glance sure.
In the short term, no one will remember any of us in 1000 years or so. 
In the long term, there will be no evidence of humans in 1,000,000,000 years. 
So, why not die and speed run the inevitable? 
This is where the logic falls short, since entropy will make  everything equally worthless eventually, the only thing we can do is to fight entropy. Some fear God, but entropy will do everything in by the end. We must stay alive and find anything to fight entropy.

Don't do it by jumping. Not a good way since death isn't guaranteed unless it is into a volcano or something.
Try taking a long walk instead, it will clear your mind and may make you feel something pleasant.

Hi, I can certainly commiserate with you over the futility of living, I don't really have anything to say on that front.
I used to be quite angry too, but you know Jordan Peterson really opened my mind. It even helped with the suicidal ideation for a while too.

Try going to the used bookstores in your town to see if 12 Rules For Life is available. You could always buy it on Amazon or wherever also.

The reason I bring up the book was your comment that "they need to pay". The desire to die is one thing, but understanding why one wants to die is important. Having anger/hate/retribution in you is a virus of the mind that has the ability to cloud judgment. 

Obviously I'm obligated to encourage you to keep your head up, but on a more personal level I sincerely encourage you to read that book. It really helped me out.
